name: Mhin
source:
“If you come any closer, you'll get hurt.”

Mhin is a relative newcomer to Eridia, working as a freelance Soulless Hunter. Sullen and short-tempered, they keep everyone at arm’s length to conceal a horrible secret: a violent Monster hides within their delicate frame. They see themselves as a threat to everyone around them—and they might be right.

Like you, Mhin has come to Eridia in hopes of finding a cure, but they’ve hit a dead end. If you work together, you might be able to find answers, but can you trust someone just as desperate for salvation as you?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/touchstarved/touchstarved?ref=f3kxoe]Kickstarter[/url]]
